title: Recordation
text:
19.06.060 Recordation.
The property owner shall submit the approved minor plat, incorporating any required revisions, to the city manager, or designee, who shall cause the minor plat to be recorded in the property records of the county.
(Ord. 16882 § 2 (part), 2008)
Chapter 19.07 REVISIONS TO RECORDED PLATS
